description: Portal <-> BC identity through app_bc_entity_map, the only verified link for records BC renumbered, served by the reporting API since plx-customer-portal TASK-3525 (promoted from pending/ 2026-10-27, devloop/DECISIONS/2026-10-27-flagship-margin-entity-map.md). Each link joins on the BC systemId the drain stored, so it names one record of one BC company: the company the BC end's capture is (its lineage bc_<book>).

object_types.description: Portal's identity bridge app_bc_entity_map: (entity_type, source_system, source_id) -> BC systemId + No., written only by the BC drain from the BC response, with the BC company (bc_company_id) and environment (bc_environment) it posted to. The joins below go through bc_system_id (the GUID the Portal resolves by), so they name one BC record of one company.

availability.reason: Only portal/LINKED rows of the joined entity types in the Production environment are bound; distribution-book clones ('{id}::distribution') do not join a Portal id; rows naming a BC company this host does not capture reach no BC record (no link).

bindings.note: Only the rows the Portal's own entity-map joins read: source_system 'portal', status 'LINKED' and an entity type a link below joins through (document-finance-queries.ts, po-queries.ts, ensure-line-prices.ts; plx-customer-portal@c3ffda3), in the BC environment the Workbench captures (Production). ARCHIVED/BLOCKED rows, other entity types and other environments are not projected. C0 `via` has no row predicate, so the entity type of each link is not tested per link: every link joins on bc_system_id against one BC entity set (salesOrders, salesInvoices, purchaseOrders, items), and a BC systemId names one record of one entity set, so a row of another entity type cannot reach that set (devloop/OPEN-DECISIONS.md entity-map-via-predicates). Live 2026-10-27 (counts only): every served row is Production; 9,673 of 9,677 item rows of the captured company and 352 of 352 purchaseOrder rows match a captured BC record, so the served replica points at the captured Production records, not UAT (operating/link_contracts.json portal-entity-map-to-bc-item).

properties.name: entity_type
properties.description: BC entity the row maps; bound only for the entity types a link joins through (salesOrder, salesInvoice, purchaseOrder, item).

properties.name: source_system
properties.description: portal | fm | sage; only portal rows are bound.

properties.name: source_id
properties.description: The Portal record id ('{id}::distribution' / '{id}::manufacturing' for book slices).

properties.name: bc_system_id
properties.description: BC systemId GUID of the mapped record (company of the drain).

properties.name: bc_number
properties.description: BC No. of the mapped record after the drain's refresh (the renumbered document No.).

properties.name: bc_company_id
properties.description: BC company id the drain posted to (the company of the row's bc_system_id); text, never an identifier the resolver follows.

properties.name: status
properties.description: LINKED | ARCHIVED (cancelled in BC) | BLOCKED; only LINKED rows are bound (the Portal's joins read no other).

properties.name: last_synced_at
properties.description: Last drain write of this row.

properties.name: bc_environment
properties.description: BC environment the drain posted to; only Production rows are bound.

link_types.name: bc_posted_as
link_types.description: The BC sales order the Portal posted this gold order as (entity map salesOrder row). Survives BC renumbering: the map holds the BC systemId, whatever No. either side shows.

link_types.name: posted_for_order
link_types.description: The gold order a BC sales invoice was posted for (entity map salesInvoice or salesOrder row whose bc_system_id is the invoice systemId): the Portal's most authoritative invoice -> order path.

link_types.name: bc_posted_as
link_types.description: The BC purchase order the Portal posted this gold PO as (entity map purchaseOrder row), through BC renumbering.

link_types.name: bc_posted_as
link_types.description: The BC item the Portal created for this product (entity map item row). Manufacturing-book rows only until book slices join (distribution clones are '{id}::distribution').

portal.bc_entity_map_table.note: app_bc_entity_map: id PK; unique (entity_type, source_system, source_id); source_system portal|fm|sage; bc_system_id = BC systemId GUID; bc_number = BC No.; bc_external_document_number (defined, never written); status LINKED|ARCHIVED|BLOCKED. No company column.

portal.bc_entity_map_upsert.note: Only the drain writes it: source_system 'portal', source_id = the outbox entity_id, bc_system_id / bc_number from the BC response of the company the drain posted to; lookupSystemId resolves by (entity_type, 'portal', source_id) with no status filter (the read joins in document-finance-queries.ts and po-queries.ts do require status 'LINKED').

portal.bc_sync_sales_order.note: salesOrder row: source_id = gold SO id (distribution book: '{id}::distribution', posted to PLX Distribution); bc_system_id = BC salesOrder id; bc_number = the BC document No. after refresh; then alignPortalSoNumberToBc rewrites order_number to it.

portal.bc_sync_sales_invoice.note: salesInvoice row (direct path): source_id = gold SO id, bc_system_id = BC salesInvoice id, bc_number = BC invoice No. (historical, before TASK-2271 removed ship-invoice mode: rows were keyed by the shipment slice id instead, syncSalesShipment 620-764).

portal.bc_sync_purchase_order.note: purchaseOrder row: source_id = gold PO id, bc_system_id = BC purchaseOrder id, bc_number = BC No.; alignPortalPoNumberToBc then rewrites po_number.

portal.bc_resolve_invoice_order.note: Strategy A (most authoritative): entity_type IN ('salesInvoice','salesOrder'), source_system 'portal', bc_system_id = the BC invoice systemId -> source_id is the gold SO id.

portal.bc_book_slice.note: Distribution clones are keyed '{id}::distribution' (parseMasterBookSlice: no suffix = manufacturing). The book is encoded in source_id only; C0 cannot derive a company from it, so clones do not join a Portal id (devloop/OPEN-DECISIONS.md bc-entity-map-book-slice).

portal.bc_item_number.note: item row: source_id = app_product id; BC Item No. = bcItemNumber(code). Product.erpCode is the Sage IC key, stamped into BC only as an Item Reference by AL (item-search-refs.ts), which api/v2.0 items does not serve.

workbench.bc_systemid_scope.note: The join is on the BC systemId GUID the drain stored, not on a number, so it names one record of one company. BC bindings key a record by its systemId alone, so a GUID that answers in two companies (a copied company) is two records under one binding key: the projector drops both (gap binding_key_not_unique) and no entity-map link reaches either; it never guesses which company is meant. A number answering in two companies is the other case: an ambiguous lead that lists the companies.

context.portal.4.10.note: BC posting / sync semantics; app_bc_entity_map is served by the reporting API since TASK-3525 (bc_* snapshots are not).

portal.bc_entity_map_linked_joins.note: The Portal's entity-map read joins name the entity_type and require source_system 'portal' and status 'LINKED': salesOrder by SO id and salesShipment/salesInvoice by shipment id (resolveSalesOrderFinanceMatchKeys, lines 88-100), purchaseOrder by PO id (resolveBcPoNumbers, 210-220); po-queries.ts:243-247, ensure-line-prices.ts:98-100 (item) and warehouse-transfer-sync.ts:127-130 (item) join the same way. order-identity.ts resolveOrderFromBcInvoiceId (entity_type IN ('salesInvoice','salesOrder'), no status filter) is the one identity resolver without it.
